name: SyFI/VibeSys: 4x MI300A, tuned SGLang 0.5.18, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MXFP4, 48 sessions, goodput
unit: tok/s aggregate goodput (48 concurrent sessions, SLO-filtered)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (SyFI Lab, UW). VibeSys-ported+tuned SGLang v0.5.18 on 4x AMD MI300A (128GB HBM3 each, gfx942). Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MXFP4, ~17B active, 512 experts, MTP speculative decoding. Deterministic multi-turn chat ramping to 192 sessions; SLO p95 TPOT<=250ms & p95 TTFT<=10s. Peak goodput 961 tok/s at 48 sessions = AGGREGATE across sessions meeting SLO.
notes: Stock SGLang 0.5.18 cannot serve this model on MI300A (no gfx942 MXFP4 MoE kernel); VibeSys agents wrote the fused MoE+GEMM kernels. Baseline PyTorch engine was 12.8 tok/s.
